name: Kortex
description: Kortex is a local-first, AI-augmented academic workspace designed to replace fragmented study tools (Anki, Quizlet, Chegg, and unanchored chat interfaces like ChatGPT). By combining zero-latency offline storage, multimodal STEM OCR, local vector retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and adaptive spaced repetition, Kortex transforms unstructured academic materials (syllabi, lecture slides, textbooks, and past papers) into an active-recall mastery system in a single document drop.
